title: land's pushed_tip ignores a failed fetch of the code branch
goal: bl_land.pushed_tip (ST-jhad3qba) checks the fetch of code/<id>: a failed fetch after a successful push neither raises from git rev-parse nor leaves --wait-merge reading a stale tip; land reports the fetch failure and the first pass still ends as not done yet. Found by the SP-3rzxx3m4 review.
